keltner_trend_main.feature_availability: Signal bar fully closed, prior DI and ATR state closed earlier; no outcome labels.

keltner_trend_main.parameter_provenance: ADX length14 Wilder convention, only ordinal slope; ATR10x3 from existing native family convention, no threshold fit; published formulas. Not optimized for current data.
